stem_book: [Multiple Correct] In the following K = kinetic energy, U = potential energy, and W = work. In using the expression K₂ + U₂ = K₁ + U₁ + W_other, we recognise that (a) we are assuming no friction is present (b) gravitational and elastic potential energies would be included in U₁ and U₂ (c) K and U can be either positive or negative, depending on the reference point chosen (d) W_other can be positive or negative
key: b,d PE terms include gravitational & elastic; W other may be positive or negative
work: W_other includes friction (a false); U = gravitational + elastic (b); K ≥ 0 always (c false); W_other may be ± (d)
